extract_last_user_text: extract the text content from the last user message in a conversational prompt list
create_tokenized_prompt_batch: create a TokenizedPromptBatch dataclass with prompt_ids and prompt_mask tensors
build_prompt_tokenizer: build a PromptTokenizer instance from a trainer to tokenize prompt inputs consistently
apply_prompt_template: apply a chat template to a list of prompts using the trainer's processing class
tokenize_prompts: tokenize a list of prompts into padded prompt_ids and prompt_mask tensors
